brand.headline: See where your energy goes — and where it's wasted.
points: Live consumption per machine, from low-cost EnergyFlow devices.
Waste detected in €, kWh and kg CO₂e, with safe one-tap actions.
Sustainability reports built from measured data, not estimates.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: How {{company}} is using energy.
overview.emptyBody: EnergyFlow starts measuring as soon as the first device is connected. Meanwhile, finish setting up your company.

company.title: Company profile
company.body: Sector, employees and turnover — used in your sustainability reports.

schedule.title: Working hours
schedule.body: When your machines should run, so EnergyFlow can spot after-hours waste.

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.body: Your day and night rates, so every kWh is costed correctly.

device.title: First device
device.body: Connect an EnergyFlow Node to a machine or electrical panel.

live.description: Real-time power for every machine and the live energy flow from the grid.
live.emptyBody: Connect an EnergyFlow device and readings will appear here every few seconds.

machines.description: Each machine's consumption, cost, CO₂e, schedule and energy fingerprint.
machines.emptyBody: Add the machines you want to monitor and link each one to a device channel.

devices.description: EnergyFlow nodes, their connection status and electrical readings.
devices.emptyBody: Provision an EnergyFlow Node to start measuring voltage, current, power and energy.

waste.description: After-hours running, idle machines and abnormal consumption — in kWh, € and CO₂e.
waste.emptyBody: Waste events appear once EnergyFlow has a few days of measurements to compare against.

opportunities.description: Savings opportunities ranked by € and CO₂ impact, with a what-if simulator.
opportunities.emptyBody: Recommendations are generated from your own consumption history.

automations.description: Safe automatic actions and a complete log of every command.
automations.emptyBody: Accepting an opportunity creates an automation you can review here.

impact.description: Before/after proof of savings, adjusted for working days and weather.
impact.emptyBody: Verified savings appear here once an action has been running for at least 7 days.

carbon.description: Scope 1 and 2 emissions, carbon intensity and VSME-aligned reporting.
carbon.emptyBody: Emissions are calculated from metered electricity using Kosovo's grid factor.

reports.description: Monthly sustainability reports generated from measured data.
reports.emptyBody: Your first report can be generated once there is a month of data.

assistant.description: Ask questions about your energy, costs and carbon — answered from your data.
assistant.emptyBody: Once EnergyFlow has measurements, you can ask things like “Which machine cost us the most this month?”
